difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a quasi-compact base, an invertible sheaf ample for the second morphism and an invertible sheaf ample for the first combine into a sheaf ample for the composite: the twist of the sheaf ample on the source by a large enough power of the pullback of the sheaf ample on the middle scheme is ample for the composite. The proof takes a finite affine open covering of the quasi-compact base, reduces by the affine-open criterion for relative ampleness to ampleness on each preimage, and quotes the result that expresses ampleness of such a twist on a piece.
